turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I live in a small flat and work long hours, but I'd really love some kind of pet.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me describe all the options before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I keep coming back to a cat, independent and cuddly, but my landlord would need to agree.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A pair of budgies would be cheerful and fit in a corner, though they can be pretty noisy.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's also a fish tank, very calm and nice to look at, but you can't exactly cuddle a fish.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or I could skip owning and volunteer walking dogs at the shelter on weekends.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's the full list. Go ahead.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: With long hours, the cat fits your life best, as long as the landlord agrees, cats cope well with being alone in the day. Budgies need more attention than people think. Fish are low effort if you want something calm.
